turns.question: Why did you resist the papal election?
turns.text: We felt unworthy of the honor of pontificate and were moved by the weight of succeeding a greatly esteemed predecessor, but we relied on the strength granted by God to accept this office and to restore all things in Christ.
turns.editorialConcern: Awkward English 'honor of pontificate'; repeats unworthiness in next turn; first-person construction not a documented quotation.

turns.question: Pourquoi avez-vous résisté à la papauté ?
